title: tanacetopsis eriobasis
intro: Tanacetopsis eriobasis, commonly known as Kava or Piper methysticum, is a plant in the pepper family native to the Pacific Island region. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing anxiety, stress, and inflammation, as well as improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetopsis eriobasis include acting as a sedative and anxiolytic, due to its bioactive constituents, which include kavalactones such as kawain, yangonin, and desmethoxyyangonin. These bioactive compounds have been shown to have potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving mood.
